newsitem.title: USA: California REIT in talks with Zell Group.
newsitem.headline: California REIT in talks with Zell Group.

text.p: California Real Estate Investment Trust Thursday said it has entered into negotiations with an affiliate of Equity Group Investments Inc, an investment company headed by financier Sam Zell.
Under the terms being negotiated, California Real Estate Investment Trust said it could receive an infusion of significant new equity capital to expand the Trust.
The closing of any transaction will be subject to board approval and various other conditions.

The decision to proceed with the exploration of alternative growth strategies comes shortly after the board of trustees of California Real Estate Investment Trust recently declined to approve a stock sale transaction proposed by the Trust's majority shareholder, Peregrine Real Estate Trust.

Peregrine had previously announced an agreement to sell its 76 percent stock interest in California Real Estate Investment Trust to MDC REIT Holdings LLC, an affiliate of the investment banking firm McCown DeLeeuw & Co. California Real Estate Investment Trust said it has no information regarding the status of the Peregrine-MDC Holdings agreement.
